# WO-126: Copy button keeps keyboard focus while copying (CA-4)
Status: queued after WO-125 (same specialist; local start: tools/copilot.sh start WO-126)
Vendor: copilot
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_COPILOT.md; check-ins via tools/copilot.sh checkin)
Assigned to: Ben Adler (Copilot web-builder), local Copilot CLI
Source: GP-05 (COPILOT_PROPOSALS.md), accepted in CLAUDE-P006

## Goal
Audit CA-4: `web/src/components/CopyHash.astro` sets `button.disabled = true` before the clipboard call and
`false` in `finally`. Disabling a focused button can drop keyboard focus to <body>.

## Step 1: reproduce first
Using the offline browser harness already used by `tests/test_web_copy_hash.py` (if there is one), focus the button by
keyboard, activate it, and check `document.activeElement` afterwards. If focus does NOT drop in Chromium, STOP: write
the result in VENDOR_STATUS.md and change nothing else.

## Acceptance criteria (if reproduced)
- Replace `disabled` with `aria-disabled="true"` plus an early return while a copy is pending; the status text still
  announces; a double activation copies once.
- Add cases to `tests/test_web_copy_hash.py` (do not change existing cases): focus stays on the button, and the
  double-activation case. Label any source-level-only check as such.
- `cd web && pnpm build && pnpm check` pass; ruff on the test file passes; report real test numbers.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/components/CopyHash.astro
- tests/test_web_copy_hash.py (add cases only)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Every other file. No scratch files.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md when done; Grace summarises in COPILOT_TO_CLAUDE.md.
